verified_statements.QRH_Theorem_1_1: All Dirichlet L-functions, including zeta, zero-free Re(s)>7/8.
verified_statements.QRH_Corollary_1_2: Every odd PRIME p has least quadratic nonresidue <= C(log p)^A, A=32 admitted in proof. Does not literally state composite Jacobi bound.
verified_statements.primitive_roots_Theorem_1_2: Every finite-order Hecke L-function over every cyclotomic F containing mu12 zero-free Re(s)>1-10^-6, no conductor/height cutoff.
